ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a discrete-time negative feedback system. The input X enters a summing node, with the input terminal being a positive sign and the feedback terminal being a negative sign; after the summing node is connected a gain α; then connected a transfer function block R/(1-(3/2)R); the internal node output by this block on one hand passes through the gain β to obtain the output Y, and on the other hand branches downward, passes through a delay block R, and then feeds back to the negative terminal of the summing node. Then reason: Let the internal signal before β be u[n], then y[n]=βu[n]. From the negative feedback structure, e=x-Ru can be obtained, namely e[n]=x[n]-u[n-1]. From the forward-channel transfer function, (1-(3/2)R)u=αRe can be obtained, therefore in the time domain: u[n]=1.5u[n-1]-αu[n-2]+αx[n-1]. Multiplying both sides by β gives y[n]=1.5y[n-1]-αy[n-2]+αβδ[n-1], because x[n]=δ[n]. From the given sequence y[0]=0, y[1]=1, y[2]=3/2, y[3]=7/4. Taking the initial rest condition, when n=1 there is y[1]=αβ=1. When n=3, δ[2]=0, so y[3]=1.5y[2]-αy[1]. Substitute the numerical values: 7/4=1.5·(3/2)-α·1=9/4-α, therefore α=1/2. Also αβ=1, so β=2. Therefore α+β=1/2+2=2.5.

With y[0]=0, the listed samples give y[1]=αβ=1. Then y[2]=1.5αβ=3/2, consistent. Use y[3]=1.5y[2]-αy[1]=7/4 to get α=1/2, then β=2, so α+β=2.5.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: X goes into a plus/minus summer, then through α, then through R/(1-(3/2)R); the internal output is multiplied by β to become Y, and the same internal signal is delayed by R and fed back negatively. From the text sequence, form the generating function: 0 + R + (3/2)R^2 + (7/4)R^3 + ... . Recognize y[n]=2-2^{-(n-1)} for n≥1, so the transform is 2R/(1-R) - R/(1-R/2) = R/((1-R)(1-R/2)) = R/(1-(3/2)R+(1/2)R^2). Since x[n]=δ[n], equate this with the diagram transfer: α=1/2 and αβ=1, giving β=2 and α+β=2.5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中输入 X 先进入一个带正、负号的加法器；正端接 X，负端接从下方返回的反馈信号。加法器输出依次经过增益 α、系统块 R/(1-(3/2)R)，然后该内部输出一方面经过增益 β 得到输出 Y，另一方面向下分支经过一个 R 延迟块后反馈到加法器的负端。

推理：设中间系统块输出为 V。前向通道从加法器输出到 V 的传递函数为 α·R/(1-(3/2)R)，反馈通道为 R，且为负反馈。因此从 X 到 V 的闭环传递函数为 [αR/(1-(3/2)R)] / [1 + αR^2/(1-(3/2)R)]。再经过 β 得到 Y，所以 Y/X = αβR / [1-(3/2)R+αR^2]。

题给 x[n]=δ[n]，所以 X(R)=1，Y(R) 就等于输出序列的生成函数。序列为 y[0]=0，且 n≥1 时 y[n]=2-2^{-(n-1)}。因此 Y(R)=Σ_{n≥1}(2-2^{-(n-1)})R^n = 2R/(1-R) - R/(1-R/2) = R/[(1-R)(1-R/2)] = R/[1-(3/2)R+(1/2)R^2]。

比较 Y/X = αβR/[1-(3/2)R+αR^2] 与 R/[1-(3/2)R+(1/2)R^2]，得到 α=1/2，且 αβ=1，所以 β=2。于是 α+β=1/2+2=2.5。

The input X enters a summing node, with the input terminal being a positive sign and the feedback terminal being a negative sign; after the summing node is connected a gain α; then connected a transfer function block R/(1-(3/2)R); the internal node output by this block on one hand passes through the gain β to obtain the output Y, and on the other hand branches downward, passes through a delay block R, and then feeds back to the negative terminal of the summing node.

Then reason: Let the internal signal before β be u[n], then y[n]=βu[n]. From the negative feedback structure, e=x-Ru can be obtained, namely e[n]=x[n]-u[n-1]. From the forward-channel transfer function, (1-(3/2)R)u=αRe can be obtained, therefore in the time domain: u[n]=1.5u[n-1]-αu[n-2]+αx[n-1]. Multiplying both sides by β gives y[n]=1.5y[n-1]-αy[n-2]+αβδ[n-1], because x[n]=δ[n]. From the given sequence y[0]=0, y[1]=1, y[2]=3/2, y[3]=7/4. Taking the initial rest condition, when n=1 there is y[1]=αβ=1. When n=3, δ[2]=0, so y[3]=1.5y[2]-αy[1]. Substitute the numerical values: 7/4=1.5·(3/2)-α·1=9/4-α, therefore α=1/2. Also αβ=1, so β=2. Therefore α+β=1/2+2=2.5.
